_note: ALL PAPER. Defaults for new installs; edit freely. Percent values are relative to entry (cost basis per token incl. fees). One paper bankroll for both books: PAPER_START_CASH (default 10000). A book with no trades adopts it on startup, and auto/policy.json start_cash is set to the same value until the AI book has a trade. A book that already has trades is left as it is.

rug._note: auto exit, no confirmation, ignores the auto toggle

discovery._doc: discovery.py polls new pools every interval_s seconds. With the default four networks plus Megafilter, 20 seconds is about 648,000 calls a month, above the CoinGecko API Analyst plan's 500,000 monthly credits (https://www.coingecko.com/en/api/pricing?utm_source=grokbot&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=grokbot-memecoin-scanner&utm_content=risk-interval). The default is 60 seconds, about 216,000 discovery calls a month on that plan. On the CoinGecko API Demo (free) plan (10,000 credits a month) set a slower interval yourself. The scanner does not change interval_s. Candidates that pass deep research are queued in pending_research.json for the CoinGecko-first scanner routine (default every 15 min). If TELEGRAM_FORWARD_URL is set, each candidate is also POSTed to that webhook (faster, but every POST is a Grok Bot routine run = more quota). research_forward=false stops queuing entirely.

stream._doc: When the plan has no WebSocket (a CoinGecko API Demo (free) key), stream.py polls token prices over REST at this many seconds. A CoinGecko API Basic plan or higher uses the WebSocket. The scanner does not change this value. The CoinGecko API Demo (free) simple-price call allows 30 addresses; a CoinGecko API Analyst plan or higher allows 100 (docs: onchain simple price).

plan_tips._doc: Set plan_tips.enabled to false to hide plan-related tips. A missing-feature note is sent at most once a day. Credits used up and a rejected key still send, once per event. Scans keep their cadence either way.

take_profit._how: levels recomputed every 60s per token: base ladder multiples scaled by volatility (ATR of 1m candles as % of price), momentum (1m/15s slope), buy/sell flow (5m buy USD share from trade stream), run from launch (price vs first candle), liquidity depth (reserve). Ask on Telegram with Sell X% / Hold / Adjust when price is within approach_pct of a level or hits it.
take_profit._clip_note: clip ladder: take initial out ~2x, then 20% / 15% of ORIGINAL qty at dynamic levels; ~15% runner left to the trailing stop. Prompts Clip/Hold/Skip unless per-position Auto-clip is ON (off by default).

liquidity._doc: Paper marks and liquidity-removal alerts. exit_max_impact_pct: a full exit above this constant-product impact is illiquid / rugged (value 0). partial_impact_pct: at or above this impact, and below the exit cap, the position is labeled partial liquidity and valued at the payout the remaining pool would pay (constant-product, DEX fee, per-chain gas), not the last price. sharp_drop_pct over sharp_drop_window_min alerts on every chain from the pool reserve or the token total reserve. On a CoinGecko API Analyst plan or higher, Solana PumpSwap and Meteora DAMM v2 pools also fetch remove events (who, how much, when). A removal by the token developer_address, or a removal of at least min_remove_usd that is at least large_remove_pct_of_reserve of the pool, is a Discard reason. Other chains and DEXes skip that call. On a CoinGecko API Demo (free) key or a CoinGecko API Basic plan, a held Solana reserve drop adds one plan tip a day. alert_cooldown_s limits repeat alerts for the same position. The AI book writes an illiquid position off when its auto flag is on; auto 0 on that position keeps it. auto/policy.json risk_overrides.liquidity wins for the AI book.

nsfw._doc: When discard is true, token info is_nsfw is a Discard and a reason line. Set discard to false to keep the flag as data only.

auto_book._doc: AI autonomous book notices (batched <=1 TG msg/min). Set notify false to silence.

scout._doc: SCOUT near-miss tier for human-book alerts (lib/scout.py). Soft-only discards + strong momentum; hard reasons never.

schedule._doc: Cadence of the Grok Bot routines (set in the routine schedule, recorded here for reference). Quota tip: enable ONE scanner by default; each run uses Grok Bot quota.
